```json
{"action": "edit", "reason": "Stage-1 gain is only ~8 (L=0.15 pair) and inverter-1's trip point is not matched to the balanced o1 level. The result is a 9.5 mV systematic offset, so one output edge never fires. Longer L raises gain, and inverter-1 is now sized from the LUT so its trip equals the mirror Vgs."}
```

```python
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18, 10, 24),      # PMOS pair gm/Id
    "Lin": (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),      # PMOS pair L (gain)
    "gmid_ld": (10, 5, 16),       # NMOS mirror load gm/Id
    "Lld": (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),       # NMOS mirror load L (gain)
    "Wn1": (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),     # inverter-1 nfet W
    "Linv1": (0.3, 0.15, 0.8),    # inverter-1 L (limits crowbar, adds gain)
    "dtrip": (0.0, -0.08, 0.08),  # trip-point trim vs balanced o1 level [V]
    "Wn2": (0.8, 0.42, 3.0),      # inverter-2 nfet W
    "Wp2": (2.0, 0.42, 8.0),      # inverter-2 pfet W
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = 10e-6
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    vod = spec.get("vod", 0.01)
    Ih = iref / 2

    m1 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["Lin"], Ih, vds=0.5, vsb=0.0)
    m3 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_ld"], p["Lld"], Ih, vds=0.7)
    vbal = m3.vgs                       # o1 at balance equals d1 (diode) level

    # size inverter-1 pfet so its trip point = balanced o1 level (+trim)
    vt = min(max(vbal + p["dtrip"], 0.45), 1.3)
    L1 = p["Linv1"]
    on = lut.op("n", p["Wn1"], L1, vt, 0.9)
    op1 = lut.op("p", 1.0, L1, 1.8 - vt, 0.9)
    Wp1 = p["Wn1"] * on["Id"] / max(op1["Id"], 1e-12)
    Wp1 = min(max(Wp1, 0.42), 20.0)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinp", "ibias", "vdd", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "o1", "vinn", "ibias", "vdd", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "o1", "d1", "vss", "vss", m3)
    n.M("MN1", "o2", "o1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn1"], L1)
    n.M("MP1", "o2", "o1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, L1)
    n.M("MN2", "vout", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wn2"], 0.15)
    n.M("MP2", "vout", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wp2"], 0.15)

    # predictions
    gain = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    cinv1 = 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn1"] + Wp1) * (L1 / 0.15) ** 0.5
    c1 = m1.cdd + m3.cdd + m1.cgd + cinv1 + 0.5e-15
    i_sig = max(m1.gm * vod, 1e-9)
    dv = 0.15                            # o1 excursion needed past matched trip
    t1 = c1 * dv / i_sig
    cinv2 = 1.0e-15 * (p["Wn2"] + p["Wp2"]) + 1e-15
    i1 = max(on["Id"] * 3, 5e-6)
    t2 = cinv2 * 0.9 / i1
    t3 = cl * 0.9 / (120e-6 * min(p["Wn2"], p["Wp2"] / 2.5))
    tpd = t1 + t2 + t3
    power = 1.8 * iref * 1.03
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain1": gain, "vo1_bal": vbal, "Wp1": Wp1}
```
